integrity: The theorem has a self-contained symbolic proof. The supplementary checker verifies the first directed-Ramsey calibration and a smallest nontrivial sharp construction.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite tournaments and a fixed existential-universal prefix. Exact numerical cutoffs inherit unknown directed Ramsey numbers, and the result does not classify spectra below the endpoint.
title: Sharp directed-Ramsey cutoff for Bernays–Schönfinkel tournament spectra
